scope: Supplemental actual Genesis 1.4.5 camera-worker and stationary physics/render tests on remote GPU2. No new-UI end-to-end scan/reconstruction/apply acceptance.

relationship_to_previous_run.note: The previous required run skipped both opt-in real Genesis camera tests. These two tests were separately enabled and passed here; the original run counts are unchanged. Its software/RMW/media results did not prove an actual Genesis scene or the new UI full cycle.

source.metadata_head_note: The bench manifest sees a copy of server Git metadata at 70757e6. Runtime identity is the current e88ca97-based dirty snapshot manifest and byte hashes, not that metadata HEAD.

camera_tests.method: Existing installed persistent dev container via Compose exec, private locked venv/ROSIDL overlay; no image build/recreate.
camera_tests.egl_mapping: Inherited dev EGL exposes three GPUs; EGL_CUDA_DEVICE_NV plus cuDeviceGetUuid matched EGL index 2 to the selected GPU2 UUID.

physics_bench.method: Maintained sim-step catalog through installed Compose; GPU2-only diagnostic container using existing Sim image, removed automatically after its own run.
physics_bench.renderer: NVIDIA RTX A6000/PCIe/SSE2; software=false for both camera workers

camera_tests.asserted: Real observer RGBD first frame, both observer and hand-eye frames after a substantial joint/root/camera/target pose update, non-null camera world origins, updated image pixels, no worker failure.
camera_tests.rendering: Actual Genesis scenes and NVIDIA EGL rendering; the first observer test uses CPU Genesis and the dual-worker test requests GPU Genesis/conversion.

stationary_physics_bench.scope: Real GPU Genesis GO2+arm scene with arm hold and two asynchronous camera workers. Zero base command; active MPPI walking/solve was not exercised.
stationary_physics_bench.timing_limits: Single short stationary trial, explicit 100 ms mean whole-loop budget. Startup used a private benchmark cache; original runtime caches were not cleared. This is not a cold-start timing comparison or production moving-MPPI performance acceptance.

initial_setup_failures_preserved.failure: Existing dev lacks the NVIDIA EGL vendor JSON; initial EGL enumeration failed.
initial_setup_failures_preserved.resolution: Private validation-owned EGL vendor JSON and confirmed GPU2 CUDA/EGL mapping; no original image/root edit.

initial_setup_failures_preserved.failure: First host-side maintained bench preflight could not import PyYAML.
initial_setup_failures_preserved.resolution: Copied the existing dev image PyYAML package into the private host-tools directory for config parsing; no host scientific/ROS installation.

not_exercised: New Visual Servoing native UI with live DDS/WebRTC followed by Scene -> Scan -> reconstruction -> mesh apply in one run.
New UI Apply/cancel/stop/reconnect behavior against a real Genesis scene in one live deployment.
Active GO2 walking/MPPI solve with camera load, physical Robot or real hardware safety.
Mesh-derived grasp/embrace execution and hold verification (adapters remain unconnected).
